Name: CoopTimePause
Author: Dreamery
Description:
[size=5][b]Coop Time Pause[/b][/size]

In single-player, time stops while you watch a cutscene or talk to someone. In co-op it doesn't: the clock keeps running while your friend sits through a heart event, and you both lose half the morning. This mod fixes that and adds a pause key that any player can use.

[line]

[size=4][b]Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Cutscenes pause time.[/b] While any player is in a cutscene (heart events, story events, overnight farm events), time stops for everyone.[/*]
[*][b]Dialogue slows time down.[/b] While any player is in a dialogue box, time runs at 10% speed. You can set this anywhere from 0% (stopped) to 100% (normal).[/*]
[*][b]A pause key for everyone.[/b] Press [b]O[/b] (configurable) to pause time for all players. Anyone can press it again to unpause, no matter who paused it. A chat message shows who paused or unpaused.[/*]
[*][b]Vanilla-style indicator.[/b] While time is stopped, the time on the clock blinks, the same effect the game uses in single-player. During a manual pause, a "Time paused" scroll also appears at the top of the screen, like the one from the game's own /pause command.[/*]
[*]The manual pause turns off by itself when a new day starts, so nobody wakes up to a frozen clock without noticing.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]How it works[/b][/size]
In co-op, only the host's game moves the clock forward. Each farmhand tells the host what they're doing (free, in a dialogue, or in a cutscene), and the host uses the "strongest" state among all players: a cutscene beats a dialogue, and the manual pause beats everything. The host then tells everyone whether the clock is stopped, so every screen shows the indicator.

[b]Note:[/b] the pause only stops the clock. Players can still walk around and monsters still move. It's not a full freeze like the host-only /pause command.

[line]

[size=4][b]Configuration[/b][/size]
Use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] (optional), or edit [i]config.json[/i] in the mod folder (it's created the first time you launch the game).

[b]Host only[/b]: the host controls the clock, so only the host's settings count here.
[list]
[*][b]Pause during cutscenes[/b] ([i]PausarEmCutscene[/i]): default [i]true[/i].[/*]
[*][b]Speed during dialogue[/b] ([i]VelocidadeEmDialogoPorcento[/i]): % of normal speed, default [i]10[/i].[/*]
[/list]
[b]Per player[/b]: each player sets their own.
[list]
[*][b]Pause key[/b] ([i]TeclaPausar[/i]): default [i]O[/i].[/*]
[*][b]Show "Time paused" on screen[/b] ([i]MostrarAvisoPausaManual[/i]): default [i]true[/i].[/*]
[*][b]Blink clock while paused[/b] ([i]PiscarRelogioQuandoPausado[/i]): default [i]true[/i].[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] 4.0+[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] (optional)[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Unzip the mod into your [i]Stardew Valley/Mods[/i] folder or use the Vortex Installer[/*]
[*][b]Every player needs it installed[/b], host and farmhands. If someone joins without it, the host gets a warning, and that player's cutscenes and dialogues won't affect time.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Only does anything in multiplayer. Single-player is untouched.[/*]
[*]Uses Harmony for a single visual patch (making the clock blink). Everything else uses plain SMAPI events.[/*]
[*]Will likely conflict with other mods that change time speed or pause time in multiplayer, so use one or the other.[/*]
[*]Split-screen should work but hasn't been tested yet.[/*]
[/list]

Manifest.Name: Coop Time Pause
Manifest.Description: In co-op, time stops while any player is in a cutscene and slows down while anyone is in a dialogue. Any player can pause or unpause time for everyone with a hotkey (default O), and the clock blinks while time is stopped. All players need it installed.
Manifest.Author: Daniel
